scope: All public physical memory presets plus one legacy LPDDR; accelerated execution versus per-burst/per-page reference execution
limitation: Not hardware calibration or whole-model prediction error

metadata.known_values: component capacity and one-way directional bandwidth
analytical_assumptions: channel count unless separately cited by the preset
rank, bank, row and burst organization
open/close, command-to-data and recovery timings
burst interval is a payload scheduling budget, not measured tCCD
metadata.capacity_basis: declared capacity with an equivalent geometry rounded upward to whole rows
metadata.bandwidth_basis: explicit component one-way bandwidth; synthetic lane width does not infer pin speed
metadata.data_rate_basis: equivalent interface rate derived from declared aggregate bandwidth and synthetic width; not a measured pin speed

metadata.command_interval_basis: burst_bytes / (pin_data_rate_gbps * data_width_bits / 8); analytical scheduling budget, not JEDEC timing

analytical_assumptions: 4 equivalent ranks per channel
8 bank groups per rank × 4 banks per group
65536 rows per bank × 8192 bytes per row
64-byte burst and interleave granularity
14 ns open/close and command-to-data delays; 15 ns write recovery
metadata.assumption_source: Representative DDR5 geometry in tools/measure_memory_precision.py, adjusted to match this machine's measured aggregate capacity and interface
metadata.burst_interval_basis: 64-byte payload / (5600 MT/s × 64 bits / 8) per channel; analytical lane scheduling interval, not a disclosed command timing
metadata.capacity_basis: 2 channels × 4 equivalent ranks/channel × 8 groups/rank × 4 banks/group × 65536 rows/bank × 8192 bytes/row
